# THE CLUB TOGARI

> Asia's first fully private ski resort, in Iiyama, Nagano, Japan. Members ski the White Dragon Field, a slope open only to club members, and use an exclusive clubhouse beside it. Operated by Togari Onsen Ski Resort Co., Ltd.

- Address: 6356-2 Toyoda, Iiyama-shi, Nagano 389-2411, Japan
- Telephone: +81-269-65-2359
- Membership: by qualification review and application

## Key pages

- [Home](https://togari.jp/theclubtogari/en/): the club, member experience, exclusives, residences, access and FAQ
- [About](https://togari.jp/theclubtogari/en/#about): why the club exists
- [The experience](https://togari.jp/theclubtogari/en/#feature): private slope, clubhouse, Kanaya Resorts dining, Vector Glide rentals, garage and transfers
- [Member exclusives](https://togari.jp/theclubtogari/en/#benefit)
- [Residences](https://togari.jp/theclubtogari/en/#residence): Ski-In Ski-Out Residences for members
- [Access](https://togari.jp/theclubtogari/en/#access): private transfer from Iiyama Station (Hokuriku Shinkansen)
- [FAQ](https://togari.jp/theclubtogari/en/#faq)
- [Contact / request membership](https://togari.jp/theclubtogari/en/#contact)
- [Privacy & Cookie Policy](https://togari.jp/theclubtogari/en/policy/)
- [Japanese site](https://togari.jp/theclubtogari/)
